sources.title: さよならを教えて 攻略 (shisnap)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed Japanese PC walkthrough: common days 1-3, day-4 save, all five heroine routes and day-9 branch choices, day-11 endings, three save positions and one CG variant note. The walkthrough does not name its edition explicitly and appears to reflect the original Windows PC game; direct applicability of its literal choices and all ending behavior to the 2016 DLsite download edition remains UNVERIFIED.

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて』（2001）プレイ感想 (kqck, DLsite purchase)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed first-hand Japanese 2026 play log: author says the copy was purchased on DLsite and explicitly recounts the day-9 five-way heroine-selection prompt, selection of 御幸 and movement to 図書室, heroine-specific episodes and ending, plus a failed 望美 attempt that reached the bad ending and required replay from day 3. Important partial independent evidence for the Windows DL distribution, but product ID and all literal route-defining choices, affinity requirements, and endings are not verified; DOES NOT QUALIFY AS COMPLETE SET B.

sources.title: さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～ (ゲームカタログ@Wiki)
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese release/system source: original 2001 PC, 2011 BD, 2016 Windows DL release; five heroine locations; up to three heroine progress tracks before day 9; the normal route ending requires choosing the heroine with whom the player is most familiar at the late branching decision. Prints a day-5 three-choice example and confirms choices may not match what the protagonist actually says. Supports gate-relevant preselection affinity behavior but NOT all exact choices, save states, or individual endings.

disagreements: RESEARCH GATE BLOCKED. Set A is a complete Japanese walkthrough for the older Windows PC version, but edition-specific confirmation of the 2016 DLsite Windows download edition's exact choices and endings is not available. The independent Japanese B components are player impressions/structural context, not an exhaustive actionable walkthrough: they do not independently verify every main-route-defining choice, prerequisite, and main ending. Therefore do not generate route_*.json, do not assemble a player-facing guide.json, and do not mark this game reviewed until an independently inspectable complete Japanese Set B and exact edition equivalence are established. Set A documents five route terminals but no reproducible non-main bad-ending detours; other Japanese reports mention bad endings without enough choice-level information, so do not invent detours. Proposed order mirrors Set A solely to reuse its documented saves 1-3; no source-established mandatory heroine unlock order. Exact 2016-edition cover lookup attempted via DLsite-linked pages and image search; only work-level/original-era artwork found, no directly verified 2016-edition cover, so catalog.cover_url intentionally remains empty. Because catalog.json is new, its research-only draft PR is NOT merge-ready: tools/catalog.mjs currently requires the matching guide.json, which should only be assembled after the source gate passes. NEW LEAD (2026-11-03): Japanese Niconico gameplay videos indexed at nicozon.net/tag/さよならを教えて/f/d include heroine-specific day ranges and an ED＆BADEND video, explicitly linking VJ009745. Their descriptions were inspected, NOT the video frames or full choice sequences. Treat as unqualified Set B until full footage establishes all five paths, choices and endings and target equivalence. Additional directly inspected Japanese play reports provide evidence of the Windows 10 download build's five endings and distinguish heroine-selected versus no-heroine bad ending. They do NOT establish the exact choices needed to produce each ending, and one report explicitly speculates about the bad-end trigger. Thus no safe badEndPath or complete Set B can be authored from these reports. A Chinese-language complete CG/ending walkthrough exists at bilibili.com/read/cv8201136 but cannot serve as the required independent Japanese Set B and its differing route/save structure requires reconciliation rather than silent translation. SAVE-SYSTEM NOTE: The reader confirms playing a build that saves at choice menus. A 2016 Japanese DL-edition review confirms this behavior, but a Japanese game catalogue says the BD edition also supports it, so save behavior alone does not identify an edition. Keep the existing VJ009745 target. Do not impose the old PC save restriction. This system evidence does not satisfy the independent route-choice/ending research gate. INDEPENDENT CROSS-CHECK UPDATE (2026-11-03): Japanese DLsite-buyer first-hand log (note.com/kksk/n/nc4029dec3472) independently observes a day-9 five-heroine selection, a named heroine path and a failed heroine attempt leading to bad end; Japanese Game Catalogue Wiki confirms the late selection requires sufficient prior familiarity. These facts narrow the gate: the five-way choice alone is NOT enough to guarantee a heroine ending when previous day-4–8 choices/visits differ. A 2016 Japanese all-CG/recollection index corroborates gallery scene labels, not route inputs, and source A frequently abbreviates scene titles with ～. Never convert scene labels to simpleJp gameplay choices. Recommended order in this file is *save-efficient order copied from Set A* (Mutsuki first, Mahiru next and Miyuki before Koyori), not a universal narrative reading recommendation. Independent Japanese play reports also recommend placing Mutsuki last for narrative reasons, but their alternate order would require separately verified safe day-9 checkpoints for Mahiru; do not silently reorder the route array without resolving those actual save dependencies. Search of Japanese detailed walkthrough queries found no second directly inspectable full route-accurate B source; recorded indexed gameplay-video descriptions are NOT inspected frames. Gate A1/A2/A3 continues to fail.
